interpret.subject: order_number
interpret.derivation: 20 lowercase hexadecimal characters assigned by the server at order creation; one sample, no decodable timestamp

interpret.subject: deposit_address
interpret.derivation: Fresh service-controlled address per order (P2PKH in the sample), displayed on the order and status pages and printed in the letter; not used as a lookup key

interpret.subject: coinomize_code
interpret.derivation: 8 alphanumeric characters issued on the first order ('Your Coinomize Code' on the order page) and meant to be entered in the coinocode field of every later order so that the user never receives their own earlier coins; links a user's orders on the server

interpret.subject: Destination address in autofill
interpret.text: Autofill keeps every address typed into the form, including addresses from submissions the service rejected (it refuses a destination already in an open order); confirm against the letter or the session-restore POST body.

interpret.subject: deposit_txid
interpret.text: Tier-1 fact; best_persistence is provisional until a funded order is run.

interpret.subject: payout_txid
interpret.text: Tier-1 fact; best_persistence is provisional until a funded order is run.

interpret.subject: amounts
interpret.text: Tier-1 fact; the order page and letter print only the service minimum and the fixed per-address fee, which are service constants. best_persistence is provisional until a funded order is run.

interpret.subject: mix_mode
interpret.text: Single mixing mode for BTC; the '100% clean coins' option is a fee-and-delay preset (5%, 900 min), not a mode. ETH and XMR are shown as coming soon.

interpret.subject: session_id
interpret.text: The session id reaches disk only if Chrome is killed or set to continue where it left off; with a normal exit it is network-only.

interpret.subject: user_identifier
interpret.text: Inferred: the code field is a named text field like output_address_1, which reaches autofill and session restore; not tested.

interpret.subject: status_progression
interpret.text: Tier-1 fact; best_persistence is provisional until a funded order is run.

beyond_disk.subject: order_expired
beyond_disk.reading: Served, but without the order number: the session no longer holds the order

beyond_disk.subject: status_lookup
beyond_disk.reading: The stale CSRF token is refused (redirect to /wrong-token), yet the response body carries the live record three days after creation and after the 'valid until' time the service itself prints: order number, creation time, fee, delay, destination and deposit addresses and the current blockchain-fee tip

beyond_disk.subject: status_page
beyond_disk.reading: Answered with the record of the order the preceding replayed lookup had placed in the session; the delay and minimum shown are session defaults ('Instant', 0 BTC), not the order's values, and the meta refresh sends a browser back to the form

beyond_disk.text: We do not store any logs of your transaction, not even your IP or Bitcoin addresses. We delete all orders after 24-72 hours (Depending on choosen delay time.), but you can also delete it by yourself.
an auto-deletion occurs after 72 hours removing the records permanently
Your order is valid for 3 days and will be deleted after this time!
Your order is valid for 24 hours and will be deleted if no coins are received!
The data will be deleted after 3 days.

About 78 hours after creation, past the 'valid until' time the service prints, the lookup by order number still returned the full record of the unfunded order (number, creation time, fee, delay, destination and deposit addresses, waiting state)
The recorded PHP session no longer resolved to the order: the order page redirected to /mix-error and the letter URL to the home page

The unfunded order was still served about 78 hours after creation, past the 24-hour (letter) and 3-day (order page) deadlines. One replay; deletion may be batched or delayed rather than absent. A later replay would settle it. The 'no logs' claim is untested.
